title: Helion Energy pinned explainer
description: A pinned stage four and a half windows tall: a mono eyebrow and uppercase heading at the top over a navy-to-pale backdrop, and low down captions that take turns as you scroll, each fading out with a blur before the next fades in. A white pill button with a soft halo rises in, unblurring, as the stage arrives and its surface closes in as the stage leaves; a small Skip link sits under it.
notes: pure CSS scroll timelines; without them (or with reduced motion) the captions are listed one under another
media is a full-stage animation or film; empty it is a gradient from `secondary` (top) to `background` with a soft `glow` in the middle
the top text uses secondary-foreground, so `secondary` should be dark (it is in the Helion theme)
